paragraphs.text: A requested answer q:W→Q is decodable exactly when it is constant on these fibers, subject to APCI’s stated reachable-versus-total codomain boundary. The linear lane adds vector-space structure and represents the same collision condition by kernels, intersections, quotients, and the four sectors. A set-valued corpus construction enters the linear lane only through a declared linear realization; the four-sector formulas are not imposed on it automatically.
